name: API Surface & Worker Engine

api_module.name: api
functions_implemented: create_app() - FastAPI factory with OpenAPI toggle, central exception handlers
register_router() - Mount routers under /api/v1/{prefix} with duplicate detection
add_middleware() - Register middleware with ordering
install_middleware_chain() - Install fixed order: request_id(10)->cors(20)->auth_hook(30)->org_scope_hook(40)->rate_limit(50)
error_handler() - Map domain exceptions to status codes with {error_code, message, details} envelope
paginate() - Apply LIMIT/OFFSET + COUNT with page_size clamping 1..200
require() - Endpoint guard delegating to AUTH.rbac_can
request_context() - Extract verified claims into RequestContext
cors_config() - CORS from CMMS_API__CORS_ORIGINS with credentials=true
serve() - Uvicorn server helper
data_models: RequestContext - org_id, user_id, role, request_id, timezone

worker_module.name: worker
functions_implemented: create_celery_app() - Celery app factory with broker from CACHE.broker_url(), JSON serializer, task time limits
register_task() - Wrap tasks with logging, failure-reason persistence, retry policy
register_beat() - Add beat schedule entries
dispatch() - Dispatch tasks with optional idempotency via CACHE lock
task_status() - Return TaskStatus{state, result, error, started_at, finished_at}
single_flight() - Cluster-wide exactly-one-at-a-time via CACHE.lock
retry_with_backoff() - Exponential backoff with jitter, dead-letter on exhaustion
failed_jobs() - Return dead-letter queue entries
collect_contributions() - Call module register_tasks()/register_beat() at start()
drain() - Graceful shutdown with timeout
data_models: TaskStatus - state, result, error, started_at, finished_at
FailedJob - task_id, task_name, args, kwargs, error, retries_exhausted, failed_at

design_principles_followed: Microkernel/plugin structure - modules implement ModuleBase protocol
Modules own their domain - API owns HTTP surface, Worker owns task engine
Stable contracts - typed service ports (HttpApi, TaskEngine)
Events for decoupling - not directly used in this chunk
One codebase, multiple entrypoints - profiles support api/worker/beat
Everything is health-reportable - both modules implement health()

notes: Chunk 3 implements the HTTP surface and background job engine as specified in roadmap.json
API module provides FastAPI factory with standardized middleware chain and error handling
Worker module provides Celery integration with idempotency, retry policies, and dead-letter queue
Both modules follow ModuleBase protocol with configure/initialize/start/stop/health lifecycle
Added convenience functions register_service/get_service to core/registry.py for cleaner imports
Worker health reports UNAVAILABLE when Redis broker is not connected (expected behavior)
All functions from Chunk 3 prompt are implemented and tested
Ready for integration with Chunks 1-2 and subsequent chunks
